texture_workflow: ImageGen base color quadrants; derived normal and roughness maps; standard Principled BSDF / glTF metallic-roughness
uv_policy: Every unique prototype is smart-projected with 0.018 margin. No unintended prototype self-overlap. Repeated modular instances intentionally reuse texture coordinates. Text and irregular puddles are unique meshes.
font_cap_cleanup: Triangulated and removed collinear font-cap faces before UV packing.
